source_policy: Platinum encounter identities preserved as anchors; Mercury canon adds broader ecological variety. Static/quest Pokémon remain static and are not duplicated into random tables unless explicitly part of the area's wild identity.

route203_priority_access.gible: 4% standard slot in all four time periods
route203_priority_access.riolu: 1% standard slot in all four time periods
route203_priority_access.location: Route 203 grass immediately outside Oreburgh Gate

special_static_preservation.valley_windworks_normal_drifloon: unchanged static availability; not added to random grass
special_static_preservation.delta_drifloon: story-only Delta event; not added to random grass
special_static_preservation.fuego_meltan: stationary Hex-Nut quest encounter; not added to random grass
special_static_preservation.eterna_celebi: future shrine side-quest static; not added to random grass

encounters_oreburgh_gate_1f.identity: Oreburgh Gate upper passage — early mining/cave ecosystem. Keeps Platinum Zubat/Psyduck/Geodude anchors, adds Mercury's early Fire/Rock option via Slugma and broader cave variety.

encounters_oreburgh_gate_b1f.identity: Oreburgh Gate lower chamber — deeper, wetter continuation with the same mining identity and a modest increase in evolved/rare cave species.

encounters_oreburgh_mine_b1f.identity: Oreburgh Mine B1F — working mine ecology with rock, mineral, burrowing and heat-adapted species.

encounters_oreburgh_mine_b2f.identity: Oreburgh Mine B2F — deeper mineral seam with stronger Onix, Drilbur, Nacli, Aron and rare Carbink/Glimmet.

encounters_eterna_forest.identity: Eterna Forest — expanded woodland while preserving Platinum Buneary/Budew/Wurmple/Kricketot identity; distinct fungal and ghostly night layer.

encounters_wayward_cave_1f.identity: Wayward Cave 1F — Bronzor/Geodude/Zubat/Onix core with earlier visible Gible access and modern cave specialists.

encounters_wayward_cave_b1f.identity: Wayward Cave B1F — Gible den / hidden cycling chamber; Gible is common enough to be a real discovery target, not a microscopic roll.

encounters_valley_windworks_outside.identity: Valley Windworks grass/water edge — preserves Shellos/Shinx/Buizel/Pachirisu while adding wind/electric species. Normal Drifloon remains a separate static; Delta Drifloon remains story-only.

encounters_fuego_ironworks_outside.identity: Fuego Ironworks exterior — Platinum Magmar/Magnemite/Floatzel/Gastrodon base expanded with industrial Fire/Steel species. Meltan remains a stationary quest encounter.

encounters_ruin_maniac_cave_short.identity: Ruin Maniac short cave — early excavation ecology based on the sealed Mercury Route 214/Ruin Maniac species set.

encounters_ruin_maniac_cave_long.identity: Ruin Maniac long cave — deeper excavation with the same canon species set at stronger levels.

encounters_maniac_tunnel.identity: Ruin Maniac Tunnel — Mercury canonical Lv31-35 survey tunnel: Hippopotas, Diglett, Drilbur, Sandile, Dunsparce, Rolycoly, Onix, Ditto.
